title_en: Provisions of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues concerning the Application of the Company Law of the People's Republic of China (V)

articles.content_en:
Article 1: Where a related-party transaction damages the interests of a company, and the plaintiff company, pursuant to Article 84 of the Civil Code and Article 21 of the Company Law, requests the controlling shareholder, actual controller, director, supervisor, or senior officer to compensate for the losses caused, the People's Court shall not support the defendant's defense merely on the ground that the transaction has already fulfilled the procedures prescribed by laws, administrative regulations, or the company's articles of association, such as information disclosure and approval by the shareholders' meeting or the general meeting of shareholders.
Where the company does not initiate prosecution, a shareholder who meets the conditions prescribed in Article 151, Paragraph 1 of the Company Law may, pursuant to Article 151, Paragraphs 2 and 3 of the Company Law, initiate prosecution with the People's Court.

Article 2: Where a related-party transaction contract is void, rescindable, or has no effect on the company, and the company does not prosecute the counterparty to the contract, a shareholder who meets the conditions prescribed in Article 151, Paragraph 1 of the Company Law may, pursuant to Article 151, Paragraphs 2 and 3 of the Company Law, initiate prosecution with the People's Court.

Article 3: Where a director is removed from office before the expiration of his term by a valid resolution of the shareholders' meeting or the general meeting of shareholders, and the director claims that the removal has no legal effect, the People's Court shall not support such claim.
After the director is removed from office, if a dispute arises with the company over compensation and a prosecution is initiated, the People's Court shall, pursuant to the provisions of laws, administrative regulations, the company's articles of association, or the terms of the contract, comprehensively consider factors such as the cause of removal, remaining term, and director remuneration, to determine whether compensation shall be paid and the reasonable amount of compensation.

Article 4: After a resolution on profit distribution is made by the shareholders' meeting or the general meeting of shareholders, the company shall complete the profit distribution within the time specified in the resolution. If the resolution does not specify a time, the time prescribed in the company's articles of association shall prevail. If neither the resolution nor the articles of association stipulate a time, or the time exceeds one year, the company shall complete the profit distribution within one year from the date the resolution is made.
Where the time for completing profit distribution specified in the resolution exceeds the time prescribed in the company's articles of association, a shareholder may, pursuant to Article 85 of the Civil Code and Article 22, Paragraph 2 of the Company Law, request the People's Court to rescind the provision on such time in the resolution.

Article 6: These Provisions shall come into force on April 29, 2019.
Cases that have not yet been finally adjudicated after these Provisions come into force shall be governed by these Provisions; cases that have already been finally adjudicated before these Provisions come into force, or cases subject to retrial under the adjudication supervision procedure, shall not be governed by these Provisions.
Where previous judicial interpretations issued by this Court are inconsistent with these Provisions, these Provisions shall prevail.
